# Things

Things brings a Things-inspired macOS and iOS look to Obsidian, with matching light and dark palettes and an interface meant to feel native. The recorded description lists a floating action button on mobile, tag pills, many styled checkbox types with icons, emphasis colors customizable through Style Settings, JetBrains Mono for code with line numbers, and support for common community plugins.

![Things screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/colineckert/obsidian-things/HEAD/assets/main-demo.png)
